name: bygone snow
source:
When the world ends, who will you spend your final hours with? 

A short story about two people and their relationship as their time comes to an end.

[From [url=https://creatalsoft.itch.io/bygone-snow]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当世界走向终结，你将与谁共度生命最后的时光？

一个关于两个人，以及在生命的尽头他们彼此之间羁绊的短篇故事。

[摘自[url=https://creatalsoft.itch.io/bygone-snow]itch.io[/url]]
